cohort: 2,663,573 primiparous women without pre-existing chronic hypertension who delivered in France between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) significantly increased the risk of chronic hypertension in primiparous women in the first years following delivery, with hazard ratios ranging from 6.03 for GH to 13.17 for PE following GH.
